LESSON: SOIL ITS RESOURCES

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Environment and
Topic 1.3: Soil its resources

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Soil its resources. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. name the three types of soils on how different samples of soils based on their feel between their fingers characteristics  Learners to observe the particle sizes

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. name the three types of soils on how different samples of soils based on their feel between their fingers characteristics  Learners to observe the particle sizes
   In simple words: practise until you can name the three types of soils on how different samples of soils based on their feel between their fingers characteristics  Learners to observe the particle sizes. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Soil its resources using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Soil its resources in the examples.
2. Explain Soil its resources to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Soil its resources.
4. Show that you can: name the three types of soils on how different samples of soils based on their feel between their fingers characteristics  Learners to observe the particle sizes

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Soil its resources using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Soil its resources important for a Grade 3 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Share their experiences c) name the three types of soils on how different samples of soils based on their feel between their fingers characteristics
2. Observe the particle sizes d) develop interest in of the three soil samples (large, characteristics of soils as an medium and small sized particles) environmental resource.
3. Mount (using glue) the different soil samples on a chart. Learners to display the chart in the learning corner.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. name the three types of soils on how different samples of soils based on their feel between their fingers characteristics  Learners to observe the particle sizes

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
